title: A monomorphism and epimorphism of sheaves of sets is an isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ its category of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. If a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ is both a monomorphism and an epimorphism of $\Sh(\mathcal C)$, then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00WN (label lemma-mono-epi-sheaves, lines 2255-2266), last sentence ('A map of sheaves is an isomorphism if and only if it is both injective and surjective'), with the first sentence identifying injective/surjective with mono/epi
